शादी के बाद लड़की नहीं, बल्कि लड़का जाएगा अपने ससुराल! 😲🔥

Sooraj Barjatya की नई फिल्म Yeh Prem Mol Liya का trailer बुधवार को आउट हो चुका है। इस फिल्म में Ayushmann Khurrana और Sharvari मुख्य भूमिका में हैं।

फिल्म में Purva बनी Sharvari का कहना है कि वह शादी के बाद अपने परिवार को छोड़कर नहीं जा सकती। इस पर Prem बने आयुष्मान खुद उसके घर शिफ्ट होने की शर्त मान लेते हैं, जिससे उनके अपने परिवार को बड़ा झटका लगता है।

Uunchai के बाद डायरेक्टर Sooraj Barjatya इस फिल्म से सालों पुरानी शादी की परंपरा पर बड़ा सवाल उठा रहे हैं। Salman Khan और Shahid Kapoor के बाद अब आयुष्मान पहली बार Rajshri के आइकॉनिक 'Prem' के रोल में नज़र आएंगे।

Himesh Reshammiya के म्यूजिक वाली यह फिल्म 27 November 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज़ होगी। फिल्म का गाना 'Jhumka Patola' पहले ही 1 million views पार कर चुका है।

क्या आपके हिसाब से शादी के बाद लड़कों का लड़की के घर रहने जाना सही फैसला है? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय ज़रूर बताएं! 👇💬

ctx.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya trailer: Ayushmann Khurrana, Sharvari's love story challenges age-old marriage tradition of brides leaving their homes
ctx.summary: Ayushmann Khurrana becomes the new Prem in the Rajshri Films production. Helmed by Sooraj Barjatya, the film will arrive in cinemas on November 27, 2026.
ctx.text:
What if a husband moved into his wife's home after marriage instead of the other way around? Sooraj Barjatya explores this question in his upcoming film Yeh Prem Mol Liya. The trailer, unveiled on Wednesday, features Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari as a couple trying to find their way through love, family expectations and a marriage custom that has rarely been questioned. Barjatya, known for his family dramas and romantic stories, takes a familiar subject and turns the roles around.
Ayushmann Khurrana is the new Prem in Sooraj Barjatya's film universe. He plays a young man in love with Sharvari's Purva and eager to marry her. Purva, however, has one condition that makes things complicated. She comes from a family of women and does not want to leave them behind after marriage. She feels responsible for looking after her loved ones and is not comfortable with the idea of moving into her husband's home. Understanding her dilemma, Prem offers to do the opposite. He tells her he is ready to move into her house and live with her family after the wedding. The proposal comes as a shock to his own family.
At the heart of the trailer is a question that challenges a long-standing marriage tradition: why should a woman always be the one expected to leave her home? Prem's decision to move in with Purva turns that expectation around. But while he sees it as a way to be with the woman he loves, his family is not quite ready to accept it. This sets up the conflict between the two families, with Prem and Purva caught between their feelings and what is expected of them.
The story may remind viewers of Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani, which explored two people stepping into each other's family lives and understanding their different ways of living. Yeh Prem Mol Liya, however, takes on the specific expectation that a bride must leave her parental home after marriage. The trailer ends with Prem saying, “Itna bhi nahi kiya, toh kya pyaar kiya”, making his stand clear. For him, being with Purva matters more than following a tradition simply because it has always been done that way.
The film marks Sooraj's first directorial outing after Uunchai, which won a National Film Award. It also brings back Prem, a character closely associated with Rajshri Productions and its popular romantic dramas. More than a decade after the character's last big-screen appearance, which has been played by Salman Khan and Shahid Kapoor previously, Ayushmann takes on the role for the first time.
The film also features Anupam Kher, Seema Pahwa, Supriya Pathak Kapur, Swanand Kirkire, Geeta Agrawal Sharma, Saumya Tandon, Surbhi Tiwari, Krish Rao, Ashnoor Kaur Kuckreja, Shruti Seth, Shaad Randhawa, Rajesh Kumar, Girish Kulkarni and Jameel Khan.
Yeh Prem Mol Liya is produced by Rajshri Productions (P) Ltd. with Mahaveer Jain Films. Himesh Reshammiya has composed the music, reuniting with Barjatya after Prem Ratan Dhan Payo. The song Jhumka Patola has already crossed one million views. The film is set to release in theatres on November 27, 2026.
